title: backend orchestration project config
description: Project-owned provider profiles and role assignment plans for the optional backend-orchestration capability. This contract is separate from .harness/project.json and does not contain credentials.

$schema.description: Editor-facing pointer to this schema; the harness does not read it to resolve the config.

provider_profiles.description: Named project-owned provider profiles. Profile IDs are referenced by ordered assignment plans.

assignment_plans.description: Role plans with an explicit runtime-specific profile, model, and reasoning effort.

backend_zones.description: Named write/read boundaries referenced by assignment plans.

concurrency_budget.description: Maximum number of coordinator-approved active batches.

verification_commands.description: Project commands a coordinator requires as orchestration proof.

developer_verification_commands.description: Optional focused commands for a developer work dispatch. When omitted, verification_commands remains the backward-compatible developer and clean-room QA list.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this profile can satisfy; credentials are never stored here.

agent.description: Orca agent identifier selected by this project-owned profile.

write_paths.description: Optional narrower write boundary for this role. It must remain inside the assigned zone.

transport.description: How this role is executed: an explicitly selected Orca-dispatched isolated worker, or an in-process subagent of the coordinator session. Both consume the same immutable brief and must pass the model self-report.

runtimes.description: Named runtime assignments, such as codex or claude.
